channel.title: Kiki Updates
channel.description: Developer ID signed and notarized updates for Kiki.

item.description:
# Kiki 0.5.4
## Studio Hardware
- A complete light and dark visual system inspired by professional recording equipment. - Templeton sage and khaki accents, warm enamel light surfaces, and charcoal dark panels. - Hardware details across Settings, Models, Voice Studio, splash cards, meeting controls, and secondary windows. - Voice Studio uses the same full Kiki portrait and layout in both appearances.
## Listening and playback
- The live transcription window is now a compact, unobtrusive single-line HUD labeled “Listening.” - Voice reference preview can now be stopped immediately; the button changes between “Play Preview” and “Stop Preview.”
This update remains fully local, Developer ID signed, notarized by Apple, and available through Kiki’s built-in updater.

# Kiki 0.5.3
Voice Studio enrollment is clearer and more flexible:
- Choose **Quick** for a shorter setup or **Full** for a longer, more accurate voice sample. - The Full script uses the complete guided recording passage, while Quick keeps the faster existing path. - The Quick passage now ends with natural privacy language instead of legal-sounding consent copy. - The Voice Studio welcome screen gives Kiki's portrait much more presence, with the artwork on the left and the introduction on the right.
This update is fully local, Developer ID signed, notarized by Apple, and available through Kiki's built-in updater.

## Fixed
- **Open Voice Studio now opens reliably.** Splash-screen actions use native macOS button tracking and no longer conflict with window dragging. - The splash screen now uses Kiki's full dog-and-microphone app icon.
This update is fully local, Developer ID signed, notarized by Apple, and available through Kiki's built-in updater.

# Kiki 0.5.1
Voice Studio is now a clear, guided three-step workflow:
- Read the complete enrollment passage at a larger 16-point size without scrolling. - Record, preview, and save your voice with distinct controls and immediate confirmation. - Install the local voice engine with accurate progress and plain-language instructions. - See exactly why voice generation is unavailable and what step remains. - Generate automatically unlocks when your saved voice, local engine, and text are ready.
This update also prevents recording playback from continuing after Save Voice and keeps every action button on one readable line.

# Kiki 0.5.0
Kiki can now create natural speech in your own voice without sending your recording, text, or generated audio to the cloud.
## Voice Studio
- Record one guided 30–60 second reference passage with consent and live quality checks. - Download an optional 2 GB Qwen3-TTS voice engine optimized for Apple silicon. - Type or paste a script and generate speech entirely on your Mac. - Generate longer writing in natural sections, cancel work in progress, and play the result in Kiki. - Export generated speech as lossless WAV or compact M4A with AI-generation provenance metadata. - Remove the model or your voice reference independently while keeping exported audio under your control.
## Reliability and polish
- Fixed the shared custom-button hit test so General Settings, Studio navigation, and action buttons receive ordinary mouse clicks across their full visible bounds. - Improved disabled-button contrast in both light and dark appearance. - Added a polished Voice Studio launch experience and a new menu-bar feature entry.
The normal transcription path is unchanged. Voice generation uses a separate native MLX pipeline and does not reduce dictation speed or quality.
